title: Peartree's Hatch Key
summary: Unlocks the basement hatch inside Peartree House.

fields.Lock: Move the Traveller’s Chest that covers the hatch. Use this key, or bypass the lock with DC 15 Sleight of Hand.
fields.Acquisition: Bookcase opposite the hatch in Peartree House.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
